english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday noun for soil or earth used to grow plants.

exampleSentences.english: This soil is nice and rich.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 di1 nai4 tou2 hou2 fei4 gaa3

english.note: Use this when “ground” means soil or earth that plants and animals are in.

exampleSentences.english: This flower needs to be planted in the ground.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢盆花要種喺泥土入面。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 pun4 faa1 jiu3 zung3 hai2 nai4 tou2 jap6 min6
